Expanded account

Is a strong model alone enough?

MostrAI, held under Istanbul Technical University and Uyumsoft, pushed the team to answer a question that would keep coming back in later competitions: is it enough for an AI project to have a strong model? Ethosoft's answer was no—technology also needs to resolve into a meaningful problem, a clear use case, a system that can actually be applied, and real value for the people using it.

The project received the Jury's Special Award, an early signal that the team's work was being recognized for more than technical performance alone.
